incidents.finding: UptimeRobot disclosed third-party brand-impersonation emails copying their template. They stated the messages did not originate from their infrastructure, recipients were not UptimeRobot account holders, and no platform access was required. Not treated as an unresolved UptimeRobot platform compromise.
